description_en: You can call the ListServiceInstanceBill operation to query the bills of a service instance
description_zh: 调用ListServiceInstanceBill查询服务实例账单
kebab_example: aliyun computenestsupplier list-service-instance-bill --max-results 20 --next-token AAAAAfu+XtuBE55iRLHEYYuojI4= --service-instance-id si-0d0d7bc9accc4e2e8a8f --billing-cycle 2025-03 --granularity MONTHLY --billing-date 2024-12-05 --service-id service-6121296da4f44e469519 --service-version 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListServiceInstanceBill

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页行数。其中最大值为100行，默认值为20行
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The token that is used to start the next query. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, no more results exist.

If NextToken has a value, the value is the token that is used to start the next query
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the service instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/396200.html operation to obtain the service instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
服务实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/396200.html获取服务实例ID
parameters.name: service_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The billing cycle in the YYYY-MM format
parameters.name: billing_cycle

parameters.help_en:
The granularity at which you want to query bills. Valid values:

MONTHLY: by month. The bill details are consistent with the bills on the By Billing Cycle tab of the Bill Details page in User Center.

DAILY: by day. The bill details are consistent with the bills on the By Day tab of the Bill Details page in User Center.

If you set this parameter to DAILY, you must specify BillingDate
parameters.help_zh:
查询账单的颗粒度。取值如下：

MONTHLY：月。与费用中心-费用账单-账单明细-账期账单一致。
DAILY：日。与费用中心-费用账单-账单明细-按天账单一致。

选择DAILY需指定BillingDate
parameters.name: granularity

parameters.help_en: The billing date. This parameter is required only when Granularity is set to DAILY. The format is YYYY-MM-DD
parameters.help_zh: 账单日期，仅当Granularity为DAILY时必填，格式为YYYY-MM-DD
parameters.name: billing_date
